config.rationale: Residual connectivity should help with a moderate-capacity CNN for histopathology patches. Standardization matches the observed channel means and standard deviations. AdamW with cosine decay and low weight decay provides stable optimization without over-regularizing. Class weighting addresses moderate class imbalance, while small label smoothing and dropout reduce overconfidence. Augmentations add mild geometric invariance.
